designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1945 around Lake Tewaukon on the Wild Rice River in southeastern North Dakota as a refuge for migratory birds.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Tewaukon National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

review.note: Draft sentence was about Arrowwood Wetland Management District (1961). Tewaukon NWR dates to 1945 per an older FWS brochure; authority not found. Confirm with the CCP.
